earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 q326ex-991earningsrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Contact: Investor Relations (408) 523-2161 INTUITIVE ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER EARNINGS SUNNYVALE, CALIF., October 20, 2026 – Intuitive (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ISRG), a global technology leader in minimally invasive care and the pioneer of robotic-assisted surgery, today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Q3 Highlights • Worldwide procedures (da Vinci and Ion combined) grew approximately 15% compared with the third quarter of 2025. Da Vinci procedures grew approximately 14%, and Ion procedures grew approximately 31%. • The Company placed 546 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 427 in the third quarter of 2025. The third quarter 2026 da Vinci surgical system placements included 315 da Vinci 5 systems, compared with 240 in the third quarter of 2025. The Company placed 56 Ion endoluminal systems, compared with 50 in the third quarter of 2025. • The Company grew its da Vinci surgical system installed base to 12,094 systems as of September 30, 2026, an increase of 12% compared with 10,763 as of September 30, 2025. The Company grew its Ion endoluminal system installed base to 1,152 systems as of September 30, 2026, an increase of 21% compared with 954 as of September 30, 2025. • Third quarter 2026 revenue of $3.05 billion increased 22%, compared with $2.51 billion in the third quarter of 2025. • Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $523 million, or $1.49 per diluted share, compared with $704 million, or $1.95 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. • Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. included a pre-tax charge of $450 million in connection with the settlement of previously disclosed antitrust class action litigation. The third quarter 2026 expense was $347 million, net of tax, or $0.99 per diluted share. • Third quarter 2026 non-GAAP* net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $1.05 billion, or $3.00 per diluted share, compared with $867 million, or $2.40 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. • Third quarter 2026 GAAP and non-GAAP* net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. included a benefit of $22 million, net of tax, or $0.06 per diluted share, related to refunds for tariffs paid in prior periods under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”). • The Company repurchased 7.8 million shares of its common stock for $2.94 billion in the third quarter of 2026. Q3 Financial Summary Gross profit, income from operations, net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc., and net income per diluted share attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. are reported on a GAAP and non-GAAP* basis. The non-GAAP* measures are described below and are reconciled to the corresponding GAAP measures at the end of this release. Third quarter 2026 revenue was $3.05 billion, an increase of 22% compared with $2.51 billion in the third quarter of 2025. The higher third quarter revenue was driven by growth in procedure volume, higher operating lease revenue, and an increase in the installed base of systems. Third quarter 2026 instruments and accessories revenue increased by 18% to $1.80 billion, compared with $1.52 billion in the third quarter of 2025. The increase in instruments and accessories revenue was primarily driven by approximately 14% growth in da Vinci procedure volume and approximately 31% growth in Ion procedure volume. Third quarter 2026 systems revenue was $769 million, compared with $590 million in the third quarter of 2025. The higher systems revenue reflected increased da Vinci system placements and a higher lease installed base compared with the third quarter of 2025. The Company placed 546 da Vinci surgical systems, of which 315 were da Vinci 5 systems, in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 427 systems, of which 240 were da Vinci 5 systems, in the third quarter of 2025. The third quarter 2026 da Vinci surgical system placements included 291 systems placed under operating lease arrangements, of which 160 systems were placed under usage-based operating lease arrangements, Page 1 of 11 compared with 231 systems placed under operating lease arrangements, of which 115 systems were placed under usage-based operating lease arrangements in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 GAAP income from operations decreased to $593 million, compared with $760 million in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 GAAP income from operations included share-based compensation expense of $216 million, compared with $206 million in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 non-GAAP* income from operations increased to $1.27 billion, compared with $976 million in the third quarter of 2025. In October 2026, following a mediation in the “In re: da Vinci Surgical Robot Antitrust Litigation” class action, the Company reached written agreement, without any admission of liability or wrongdoing, to settle the previously disclosed antitrust litigation for a one-time payment of $450 million and mutually agreed injunctive relief. The Company recorded a $450 million charge to selling, general, and administrative expenses in the third quarter of 2026. The settlement remains subject to preliminary and final Court approval, and there can be no assurance the Court will approve it or that individual class members will not object. The third quarter 2026 expense was $347 million, net of tax, or $0.99 per diluted share. Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $523 million, or $1.49 per diluted share, compared with $704 million, or $1.95 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. included excess tax benefits of $13 million, or $0.04 per diluted share, compared with $24 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Additionally, third quarter 2026 GAAP net income included a benefit of $22 million, net of tax, or $0.06 per diluted share, related to refunds for tariffs paid in prior periods under IEEPA. Third quarter 2026 non-GAAP* net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $1.05 billion, or $3.00 per diluted share, compared with $867 million, or $2.40 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 non-GAAP* net income included a benefit of $22 million, net of tax, or $0.06 per diluted share, related to refunds for tariffs paid in prior periods under IEEPA. The Company ended the third quarter of 2026 with $6.80 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and investments, a decrease of $1.83 billion during the quarter, primarily driven by cash used for repurchases of common stock and purchases of property, plant, and equipment, partially offset by cash generated from operations. “Our strong performance this quarter was marked by broad-based adoption across our multi-port, single-port, and Ion platforms, with customers using our systems to perform, on average, over 10,000 procedures per day throughout the period,” said Dave Rosa, Intuitive CEO. “Looking ahead, we will remain focused on serving customers across geographies and sites of care, enabling them to deliver better patient care, outcomes, and experiences, reduce the total cost of care, and expand access to minimally invasive care.” 2026 Financial Outlook The Company expects the following results for the full year of 2026: • Worldwide da Vinci procedure growth of approximately 14% to 15% in 2026. The Company expects to be closer to the midpoint of this range. • Non-GAAP* gross profit margin to be within a range of 68.7% to 69.3% of revenue in 2026. This range includes an estimated impact from tariffs of 0.9% of revenue (excluding recognized tariff refunds). • Non-GAAP* operating expense growth of 11% to 13% in 2026. The range for expected non-GAAP* gross profit margin reflects the Company’s estimates of the adverse impact from tariffs that are currently in effect as of the time of this press release and assumes such tariffs remain in place through the end of the year. Should additional tariffs beyond our expectations be implemented, the additional impact on the Company’s financial results in 2026, including the change in expected non-GAAP* gross profit margin, could be material. The ultimate effect of tariffs will depend on various factors, including the proportion of components procured and finished goods manufactured outside of the United States and the amount, scope, nature, and timing of the tariffs. The 2026 financial outlook provided above includes forward-looking, non-GAAP financial measures, which management uses in measuring performance. We do not provide a reconciliation of non-GAAP outlook measures to corresponding GAAP measures on a forward-looking basis, because we are unable to predict with reasonable certainty the exact timing and ultimate outcome of certain items, including but not limited to legal proceedings, without unreasonable efforts. These items are uncertain, depend on various factors, and could be material to the Page 2 of 11 Company’s results computed in accordance with GAAP. For additional information regarding the nature of these items, refer to the reconciliations of historical GAAP to non-GAAP measures included elsewhere in this release. Additional supplemental financial and procedure information has been posted to the Investor Relations section of the Intuitive website at https://isrg.gcs-web.com/ . Webcast and Conference Call Information Intuitive will hold a teleconference at 1:30 p.m. PDT today to discuss the third quarter 2026 financial results. The call will be webcast live and can be accessed on Intuitive’s website at www.intuitive.com . For those individuals planning to participate on the call, registration can be completed online at https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/6sniqxsm to receive dial-in details and an individual pin. The webcast replay of the call will be made available on our website at www.intuitive.com within 24 hours after the end of the live teleconference and will be accessible for at least 30 days. About Intuitive Intuitive (Nasdaq: ISRG), headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, is a global leader in minimally invasive care and the pioneer of robotic-assisted surgery. Our technologies include the da Vinci surgical systems and the Ion endoluminal system. By uniting advanced systems, progressive learning, and value-enhancing services, we help physicians and their teams optimize care delivery to support the best outcomes possible. At Intuitive, we envision a future of care that is less invasive and profoundly better, where diseases are identified early and treated quickly, so patients can get back to what matters most.
